simple.meaning: צְחִיחַ (tsᵉchîyach) is a Hebrew word meaning “glaring , i.e. exposed to the bright sun.” BibleIQ connects the English word back to this source word so its use can be compared across Scripture.
simple.biblicalBackground: צְחִיחַ (H6706) appears 5 times in the Hebrew Bible, beginning at Nehemiah 4:7, with occurrences in Nehemiah, Ezekiel.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to צְחִיחַ (H6706) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: English translations can use the same English word for different Hebrew words. BibleIQ anchors the study in צְחִיחַ (H6706) before moving outward to related references.
simple.summary: צְחִיחַ (tsᵉchîyach) / H6706 is traced through Nehemiah 4:7, Ezekiel 24:7, Ezekiel 24:8, Ezekiel 26:4 using source-language evidence and occurrence comparison.
